questions.prompt: Which of these are school → college contrasts the deck makes? Select all that apply.
options: At college your day is filled in for you by your tutor
At college no one chases — the work is yours, or it doesn't get done
At college a bad week shows up the next week
At college your teachers check you've done the reading every day
questions.explanation: 'No one chases. The work is yours — or it doesn't get done.' is one of the three contrasts.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: most missed work doesn't punish you that week — it punishes you a couple of ____ later.
questions.template: Most missed work doesn't punish you that week — it punishes you a couple of ____ later.
options: days
weeks
months

questions.prompt: Which of these are 'Seek Opportunity' behaviours the deck lists? Select all that apply.
options: Join clubs and volunteer — competitions, public portfolios, student media projects
Explore careers and build skills — degrees and Higher Apprenticeships
Treat mistakes as how you learn
Wait until your final year before thinking about careers
questions.explanation: The three Seek Opportunity behaviours are join clubs, explore careers & build skills, and treat mistakes as how you learn.

questions.prompt: How does the deck reframe 'I'm finding this hard'?
options: 'That means I'm not cut out for it — I should switch course'
'That means I'm doing it properly — and I should ask'
'That means the work is unfair — I should complain'
'That means I should work in silence until I figure it out'
questions.explanation: 'I'm finding this hard. That means I'm doing it properly — and I should ask.'

questions.prompt: According to the deck, what do you lose when you're not in the room? Select all that apply.
options: The bit that isn't on the slides — off-script teaching, worked examples, questions
Spaced learning that actually sticks
The relationships that catch you when you slip
Being seen by the people writing your reference
questions.explanation: All four are the plain-case arguments the deck uses for attendance.

questions.prompt: What does the deck say is the response when coming in is hard for a real reason?
options: Issue a formal warning
Tell someone early so we can help
Wait until attendance drops below the threshold
Move the student to a different course
questions.explanation: A barrier we know about is one we can help with. Tell someone. Early.
